name: Q·升龙上挑斩 (8帧示例模板)
view_prompt: classic 2D side-scrolling 3/4 action RPG view, facing RIGHT consistently in every cell

frame_choreography.torso: Neutral upright stance matching Reference Image 1 anchored in left third
frame_choreography.arms_weapon: Right hand grips full silver sword at 35deg forward-up; left arm balanced at hip
frame_choreography.legs_feet: Both boots planted shoulder-width apart on ground baseline
frame_choreography.secondary_motion: Scarf gently flowing left; ponytail calm

frame_choreography.torso: Deep low forward crouch (-3px) compressing torso to store upward spring energy, eyes locked up-right
frame_choreography.arms_weapon: Right hand drops full silver sword low behind right knee pointing down-back (winding up for rising cut); left hand braces near chest
frame_choreography.legs_feet: Both knees bent deeply in coiled crouch, front right heel and rear left toe pressed hard into floor
frame_choreography.secondary_motion: Ponytail dips behind shoulders; scarf curls low
frame_choreography.vfx_meaning: TELEGRAPH VFX: Bright golden-orange flame spark igniting directly along the lowered blade edge + compact ground dust pressure ring under braced boots (signals upward launch attack!)

frame_choreography.role: F3 ACTIVE HIT#1 — EXPLOSIVE RISING SLASH
frame_choreography.torso: Torso uncoils sharply upward-right lifting off ground (+6px airborne!) chest opening skyward
frame_choreography.arms_weapon: Right arm whips silver sword violently bottom-to-top upward across front; left arm drives downward for counter-torque
frame_choreography.legs_feet: Front right knee drives high upward leading leap; rear left leg extends straight downward pushing off floor
frame_choreography.secondary_motion: Scarf & ponytail trail straight downward-left against upward leap
frame_choreography.vfx_meaning: ACTIVE LAUNCH VFX: Thick vertical-curving white-core -> flame-orange -> blazing crimson crescent trail sweeping strictly upward from the rising blade edge + ground launch dust erupting directly below her takeoff foot!

frame_choreography.role: F4 ACTIVE HIT#2 — APEX UPPERCUT HITSTOP
frame_choreography.torso: Airborne apex (+12px off ground!) stretched tall skyward in heroic rising silhouette
frame_choreography.arms_weapon: Right arm extended fully overhead-right holding gleaming vertical silver sword at top of rising arc; left hand tucked back
frame_choreography.legs_feet: Both boots clearly airborne — right knee tucked forward, left leg trailing cleanly down
frame_choreography.secondary_motion: Scarf streams straight down-left; ponytail swept downward
frame_choreography.vfx_meaning: ACTIVE HITBOX CLIMAX VFX: Tall sweeping blazing flame-gold & crimson rising dragon-slash crescent arcing from floor level all the way above her raised blade tip + rising embers (visually matches the tall vertical anti-air Hitbox!)

frame_choreography.torso: Gravity pulls body smoothly downward (+6px airborne), eyes checking landing spot
frame_choreography.arms_weapon: Right wrist lowers silver sword calmly toward mid-front guard; left arm spreads for balance
frame_choreography.legs_feet: Both legs extend smoothly downward preparing to touch floor
frame_choreography.secondary_motion: Scarf floats upward-left trailing behind her descent
frame_choreography.vfx_meaning: DISSIPATION VFX: Flame crescent breaks into fading rising orange embers & cooling smoke wisps (clearly indicates active hitbox ended!)

frame_choreography.torso: Compact knee-bend landing cushion (-2px) smoothly absorbing touchdown
frame_choreography.arms_weapon: Right hand steadies full silver sword forward at waist height
frame_choreography.legs_feet: Both boots plant squarely back onto ground baseline with shock-absorbing bent knees
frame_choreography.secondary_motion: Ponytail & scarf drop softly with landing inertia
frame_choreography.vfx_meaning: LANDING VFX: Small twin white-tan dust puffs kicking cleanly left and right from her landing boots

frame_choreography.torso: Rising smoothly back to neutral upright height
frame_choreography.arms_weapon: Right hand lifts full silver sword cleanly into 35deg neutral guard
frame_choreography.legs_feet: Both boots settled in balanced shoulder-width neutral stance
frame_choreography.secondary_motion: Scarf & ponytail returning calmly to idle flow

frame_choreography.torso: 95% identical to Cell 1 & Cell 9 — upright ready posture
frame_choreography.arms_weapon: Full silver sword held steady at exact 35deg Cell 1 angle
frame_choreography.legs_feet: Both boots planted cleanly in exact Cell 1 stance

frame_choreography.torso: 100% IDENTICAL TO CELL 1 — neutral upright stance in left third
frame_choreography.arms_weapon: 100% IDENTICAL TO CELL 1 — full silver sword at 35deg forward-up
frame_choreography.legs_feet: 100% IDENTICAL TO CELL 1 — both boots planted shoulder-width
frame_choreography.secondary_motion: 100% IDENTICAL TO CELL 1 — scarf and ponytail exact match
